newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic in D.C. pact with MCI.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic in D.C. pact with MCI.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said Tuesday it signed a local interconnection and resale agreement in Washington, D.C., with the local service affiliate of MCI Corp.

The company said it expects approval from the D.C. Public Service Commission within a month. The pact to connect their networks is the fourth signed between Bell Atlantic and MCI, following New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Virginia.
The agreement allows MCI to resell Bell Atlantic local phone service under the MCI brand as well as to have access to Bell Atlantic databases and ordering systems and certain interconnection rights.
MCI will allow Bell Atlantic customers to complete calls made to MCI customers and offer number portability.
Further details of the pact were not disclosed.
